title: Food Canning & Preservation
description: Step-by-step water bath canning for high-acid foods and pressure canning for low-acid foods, with processing times and botulism prevention. Also covers dehydrating, curing and smoking meat, fermenting sauerkraut, kimchi, and pickles, tested starter recipes, and labeling and shelf life.
shortDescription: Water bath and pressure canning, botulism safety, drying, smoking, fermenting
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
